description: This file contains Redux action creators and async thunks for managing posts in Mattermost, including fetching, creating, deleting, reacting, pinning, and thread management.

methods.name: receivedPost
methods.description: Dispatches an action indicating a single post has been received or updated.

methods.name: receivedNewPost
methods.description: Dispatches an action indicating a new post has been received or sent.

methods.name: receivedPosts
methods.description: Dispatches an action with multiple posts, possibly unordered.

methods.name: receivedPostsAfter
methods.description: Dispatches an action with posts that come before a specific post.

methods.name: receivedPostsBefore
methods.description: Dispatches an action with posts that come after a specific post.

methods.name: receivedPostsSince
methods.description: Dispatches an action with posts updated since a timestamp.

methods.name: receivedPostsInChannel
methods.description: Dispatches an action with posts within a channel when adjacency is unknown.

methods.name: receivedPostsInThread
methods.description: Dispatches an action with posts in a thread.

methods.name: postDeleted
methods.description: Dispatches an action indicating a post has been deleted, replacing it with a placeholder.

methods.name: postRemoved
methods.description: Dispatches an action to immediately remove a post.

methods.name: postPinnedChanged
methods.description: Dispatches an action indicating a post's pinned status has changed.

methods.name: getPost
methods.description: Async function to fetch a post by ID from the server.

methods.name: createPost
methods.description: Async function to create a new post, handling files and optimistic updates.

methods.name: resetCreatePostRequest
methods.description: Resets the create post request state.

methods.name: deletePost
methods.description: Async function to delete a post.

methods.name: editPost
methods.description: Function to send an edit request for a post.

methods.name: setUnreadPost
methods.description: Marks a post as unread for a user.

methods.name: pinPost
methods.description: Pins a post in a channel.

methods.name: decrementPinnedPostCount
methods.description: Decrements the pinned post count for a channel.

methods.name: unpinPost
methods.description: Unpins a post in a channel.

methods.name: addReaction
methods.description: Adds a reaction emoji to a post.

methods.name: removeReaction
methods.description: Removes a reaction emoji from a post.

methods.name: getCustomEmojiForReaction
methods.description: Fetches custom emoji data for a reaction if not already available.

methods.name: flagPost
methods.description: Flags a post as important or noteworthy.

methods.name: getPostThread
methods.description: Fetches a thread of posts starting from a root post.

methods.name: getNewestPostThread
methods.description: Fetches the latest posts in a thread.

methods.name: getPosts
methods.description: Fetches posts in a channel with pagination.

methods.name: getPostsUnread
methods.description: Fetches unread posts in a channel.

methods.name: getPostsSince
methods.description: Fetches posts updated since a timestamp.

methods.name: getPostsBefore
methods.description: Fetches posts before a specific post.

methods.name: getPostsAfter
methods.description: Fetches posts after a specific post.

methods.name: getPostsAround
methods.description: Fetches posts around a specific post, combining before and after.

methods.name: getPostThreads
methods.description: Fetches threads for an array of posts.

methods.name: getMentionsAndStatusesForPosts
methods.description: Loads user profiles and statuses for users mentioned or involved in posts.

methods.name: getPostsByIds
methods.description: Fetches multiple posts by their IDs.

methods.name: getPostsByIdsBatched
methods.description: Batched loader for fetching posts by IDs.

methods.name: getPostEditHistory
methods.description: Fetches edit history for a post.

methods.name: removePost
methods.description: Removes a post from the store, handling system posts and pinned status.

methods.name: moveThread
methods.description: Moves a thread to another channel.

methods.name: selectFocusedPostId
methods.description: Selects a post as focused.

methods.name: unflagPost
methods.description: Removes a flag from a post.

methods.name: addPostReminder
methods.description: Adds a reminder to a post.

methods.name: doPostAction
methods.description: Performs an action on a post.

methods.name: doPostActionWithCookie
methods.description: Performs an action on a post with additional cookie data.

methods.name: addMessageIntoHistory
methods.description: Adds a message to the message history.

methods.name: resetHistoryIndex
methods.description: Resets message history navigation index.

methods.name: moveHistoryIndexBack
methods.description: Moves message history navigation back.

methods.name: moveHistoryIndexForward
methods.description: Moves message history navigation forward.

methods.name: resetReloadPostsInTranslatedChannels
methods.description: Reloads posts in channels with auto-translation enabled.

methods.name: resetReloadPostsInChannel
methods.description: Resets and reloads posts in a specific channel.

methods.name: acknowledgePost
methods.description: Acknowledges a post for the current user.

methods.name: unacknowledgePost
methods.description: Removes acknowledgment from a post.

methods.name: restorePostVersion
methods.description: Restores a previous version of a post.
